# SplitXY

<!-- gen:begin summary -->
<!-- Generated by `npm run generate:op-docs` from noodles-validate/registry.json. The title and the text between gen:begin and gen:end markers are replaced on every run; write anywhere else. -->

Split a 2D vector into its x and y components.
<!-- gen:end summary -->

## Syntax

<!-- gen:begin syntax -->
```json
{
  "id": "/split-xy",
  "type": "SplitXYOp",
  "position": { "x": 0, "y": 0 },
  "data": { "inputs": {} }
}
```

Expressions and code read its fields as `op('/split-xy').par.vec` (an input) and `op('/split-xy').out.x` (an output). Edges name the same fields as handles: `par.vec`, `out.x`.
<!-- gen:end syntax -->

## Inputs

<!-- gen:begin inputs -->
| Name | Type | Default |
|------|------|---------|
| `vec` | `Vec2Field` | `{"x":0,"y":0}` |
<!-- gen:end inputs -->

## Outputs

<!-- gen:begin outputs -->
| Name | Type |
|------|------|
| `x` | `NumberField` |
| `y` | `NumberField` |
<!-- gen:end outputs -->
